# Amana'Accounts

> Chartered accountants based in the UAE, providing accounting, bookkeeping, VAT and
> corporate tax services to freelancers, startups and SMEs across Dubai and the wider
> UAE. Engagements are led by ACA and CTA qualified advisers with over a decade of
> experience across the UAE and UK. Official Wafeq partner.

Contact: info@amanaaccounts.com · +971 55 142 9144
Address: Al Shmookh Business Center, M 1003, One UAQ, UAQ Free Trade Zone, Umm Al Quwain, UAE
Languages: English

## Services

- [Accounting & Bookkeeping](https://www.amanaaccounts.com/accounting-and-bookkeeping): Wafeq software setup and licensing, monthly transaction posting and bank reconciliation, sales invoicing and expense records, IFRS-compliant annual financial statements.
- [VAT](https://www.amanaaccounts.com/vat): FTA registration and deregistration, quarterly and monthly filing through EmaraTax, automated bank-to-VAT integration, VAT refunds.
- [Corporate Tax](https://www.amanaaccounts.com/corporate-tax): FTA corporate tax registration, annual calculation and filing, tax planning and liability mitigation, FTA correspondence and support.
- [Business Advisory](https://www.amanaaccounts.com/business-advisory): Company formation and incorporation, free zone selection, cross-border and expat tax planning, PRO services, mergers and acquisitions.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://www.amanaaccounts.com/pricing): Published rates with no setup or hidden fees. VAT registration AED 1,000 one-off. Corporate tax registration AED 1,000 one-off. Monthly bookkeeping AED 1,250 per month. Quarterly VAT returns AED 1,000 per quarter. Annual corporate tax return AED 3,000 per year. Bespoke advisory quoted on request. Plans can be changed or cancelled at any time with no long-term commitment.
